operations.title: Conditional symmetric powers collapse to identity Adams operations on pi_0
operations.statement: The D4_ab-labelled finite-component rig groupoid admits functorial exterior and symmetric powers. On pi_0 they give lambda_t(m)=(1+t)^m and sigma_t(m)=(1-t)^(-m), the binomial lambda structure, whose Adams operations satisfy psi^n(m)=m for every n. Nontrivial power data can only remain in the wreath-product stabilizers (D4_ab)^n semidirect S_n erased by pi_0.
operations.scope: Exact conditional algebraic rig; the D4_ab quotient is not physically authorized and no Witt, Frobenius, or Euler object is asserted.

operations.title: Binomial lambda Adams hostile test
operations.procedure: Derive lambda_t(m) from r-subsets of an m-component set and compute Adams operations by the logarithmic derivative identity. Track the pre-decategorization automorphism group of n identical components.
operations.expected_result: Every decategorified Adams operation is identity, while pre-decategorization stabilizers retain wreath-product cycle types. A nonidentity psi^n on component count falsifies the claim.
